scope: Remove the redundant learning progress sheet and its level/star tap target
cause: The level/stars/next-star block was a full-width Button presenting LearningProgressOverview. ChatLearningPager itself contains only chat and learning. The sheet and button were unnecessary secondary navigation in the horizontal gesture area.

removed: Level/star button action, press style and navigation accessibility hint
change.retained: Inline level, nine-star row, next-star points, star landing anchor, challenge entry, history and promotion flows. Progress now has a noninteractive accessibility container.

regression.before: New test reproduced the extra page by tapping the star row; assertion failed because the learning progress navigation bar appeared.

testFixture.issue: XCTest requested the active fixture but the target process received UI_TEST_LEARNING_PAGE_STATE=ready. Confirmed the requested value in the test attachment and sampled only the relevant target environment key.
testFixture.fix: Debug preview service accepts an explicit --learning-preview-state launch argument before the environment fallback. Layout tests pass the selected state as an argument; the live service is unchanged.

coverage: Tap star row without opening a sheet
Inline level/stars retain their layout within the challenge card
Maximum accessibility text in dark history
Pending, accuracy and combined history filters
Vertical scroll and both horizontal drag directions starting in the stars region; return button and swipe preserve chat draft without reopening the keyboard
Real-page star animation lands and updates points after removal of the button

visualReview.method: Xcode-hosted interactions and native screenshots; Computer Use tools unavailable.
visualReview.review: Inspected the unchanged main-card layout, tapping stars while remaining on the page, and the returned chat with its saved draft. No photo assets changed.

preview.result: Build, installation and launch succeeded; left latest role-learning preview on the existing iPhone 18 Pro.

dataSafety: No account data, scoring policy, backend, database, source assets or production services changed.
